title: Make the resend-code cooldown testable
acceptanceCriteria: `resendLabel(now, lastSentAt)` is exported and counts down from the `now` it is given, not the real clock
Exactly 60 s after a send, the label is "Resend code"
The seconds left round up, so the label never says "Resend in 0s"

`createCodeSender({ now, send })` sends the first code at once, refuses inside the cooldown without sending (returning the seconds to wait, rounded up), and sends again once 60 s have passed on the injected clock
Two requests in quick succession — a double click — send only one code
